jobs.title: Implementation Project Manager, icometrix
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

As part of the GE HealthCare MR organization, the USCAN MR Clinical AI Implementation Specialist – icobrain will be responsible for leading the successful deployment of icobrain at customer sites across the U.S. and Canada, from project kickoff through go-live and handoff to ongoing support.

This is a newly created role, added to support the continued growth of icobrain within GE HealthCare MR. The successful candidate will join the existing icobrain Implementation Specialist in USCAN, sharing the customer implementation workload and helping to strengthen and scale how implementations are delivered.

This role sits at the intersection of technology and clinical workflow. The successful candidate will plan and execute technical software implementations, connecting icobrain's cloud-based platform with customer MR scanners, PACS, and RIS environments through DICOM and HL7, while making sure each deployment fits the way the customer's MR department works day to day.

The role operates within a matrixed organization, reporting into GE HealthCare MR while dedicated specifically to icobrain. The Implementation Specialist will partner closely with their fellow icobrain Implementation Specialist, MR Sales, the Clinical AI Sales Specialist, Customer Success, icometrix product and support teams, GE HealthCare service and IT/security teams, and customer stakeholders. Across all of these relationships, the customer always comes first.

Because icobrain is a growing part of the GE HealthCare MR portfolio, this role will also help formulate and document the implementation process itself, building the repeatable workflows, playbooks, and standards that allow the team to scale.

This is a primarily remote role, with most implementation activity, including kickoffs, configuration, testing, and customer meetings, conducted virtually through phone and Microsoft Teams. Travel to customer sites will be required as needed for key milestones such as go-lives, workflow assessments, and escalations.

The ideal candidate brings a client-first mindset to every interaction and is self-motivated, proactive, and highly organized, someone who takes control of issues and is eager to drive them to resolution.

Job Description

Lead end-to-end implementations: Own icobrain deployments from contract handoff through go-live, including kickoff, scoping, scheduling, configuration, testing, training coordination, and transition to Customer Success.
Put the client first: Serve as the customer's primary point of contact throughout implementation, setting clear expectations, communicating proactively, and ensuring a positive experience at every step.
Integrate icobrain into the customer environment: Configure and validate DICOM connectivity and routing between MR scanners, PACS, and the icobrain cloud platform, and support HL7 interfaces and RIS integration for orders and results as required.
Align the solution with MR department workflow: Work with MR technologists, radiologists, neuroradiologists, and imaging leaders to understand current workflows, protocols, and reading practices, and configure icobrain to fit seamlessly into them.
Navigate security and IT requirements: Partner with customer IT and information security teams on security questionnaires, network and gateway configuration, firewall and access requirements, and data privacy reviews, including HIPAA and applicable Canadian privacy requirements.
Take ownership and drive to resolution: Proactively identify risks, troubleshoot technical issues, and coordinate across customer and internal teams to resolve them quickly, keeping projects on schedule and stakeholders informed.
Formulate and document processes: Working with the existing Implementation Specialist, help design, standardize, and document implementation processes, checklists, playbooks, and best practices for icobrain in USCAN, and continuously refine them based on lessons learned.
Build relationships, internally and externally: Develop trusted relationships with customer clinical, IT, and administrative stakeholders and with GE HealthCare MR Sales, Clinical AI Sales, Customer Success, service, and product teams, always keeping the customer's needs at the center.
Manage multiple projects with discipline: Track milestones, risks, actions, and documentation in established tools, and provide clear, timely status updates to customers and internal leadership.
Support existing customers and contract transitions: Partner with Customer Success on reconfigurations, upgrades, site expansions, and the technical aspects of transitioning legacy icometrix customers to GE HealthCare agreements.
Bring the voice of the customer back to the organization: Share implementation insights, recurring technical issues, and customer feedback with Product, Customer Success, and MR leadership to improve both the product and the implementation experience.

Required Qualifications

3+ years of experience leading technical software implementations, ideally in healthcare IT, medical imaging, clinical software, or a related field.
Working knowledge of cloud applications and SaaS deployment models, including connectivity, gateways, and cloud security considerations.
Solid understanding of DICOM and HL7 fundamentals, such as DICOM routing, AE titles, and modality worklists, and HL7 order and result messaging.
Understanding of RIS and PACS systems and how they interact within radiology workflow.
Knowledge of healthcare IT security and privacy, including network security, access controls, security questionnaires, and HIPAA.
Proven project management skills, with the ability to run multiple implementations at the same time and keep them on track.
An excellent client-first mindset, with a track record of building trusted relationships with customers while working effectively with internal teams.
Self-motivated and proactive, comfortable taking control of a situation and eager to drive issues to resolution with minimal direction.
Highly organized, with strong documentation skills and experience creating or improving processes, playbooks, or standard work.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to clinical, IT, and business audiences.
Ability to work effectively in a matrixed organization, collaborating across MR, icobrain, Customer Success, service, and product teams while maintaining ownership of assigned implementations.

Preferred

Hospital or healthcare background is strongly preferred, ideally in MRI or radiology (for example, MR technologist, PACS or imaging informatics, or clinical applications).
Understanding of MR department workflow, including scheduling, protocoling, image acquisition, and reading and reporting, is strongly preferred.
Experience with clinical AI, neuroimaging, or advanced visualization software is a plus.
Ability to work effectively in a primarily remote model, with travel as needed for customer go-lives, site visits, and other key milestones.
Most importantly, a genuine commitment to making every customer successful with icobrain and to advancing MR and neurological care through clinical AI.

We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. For U.S. based positions only, the pay range for this position is $112,800.00-$169,200.00 Annual. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the pay range and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including skills, qualifications, experience and location. In addition, this position may also be eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). GE HealthCare offers a competitive benefits package, including not but limited to medical, dental, vision, paid time off, a 401(k) plan with employee and company contribution opportunities, life, disability, and accident insurance, and tuition reimbursement.

GE HealthCare offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: US Customer Delivery Project Manager
jobs.description:
About the Role

AppGate Professional Services is looking for a customer-focused Customer Delivery Project Manager to lead the implementation of our Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) platform for US commercial customers. As the primary customer-facing lead for medium to large engagements, typically two to six months long, you will own delivery from project handover through production go-live and transition to Support and Customer Success.
This is a delivery leadership role, not a sales or account management position. You will manage scope, schedule, budget, deliverables, and expectations across structured, milestone-driven projects, working alongside AppGate engineers so they can stay focused on architecture, configuration, and customer enablement. Professional Services operates as a P&L, so this role directly influences project profitability, revenue realization, and services margin. Success is measured by on-time milestone delivery, customer satisfaction at go-live and close-out, project financial performance, and clean handover to Support with complete close-out documentation.

Key Responsibilities

Customer and Stakeholder Management

•Serve as the primary AppGate point of contact for US commercial customers throughout service delivery, managing day-to-day requests and communication.
•Build strong working relationships with customer IT and security teams, project sponsors, and executive stakeholders.
•Lead status calls, milestone reviews, and stakeholder briefings so all parties have a clear, accurate view of progress, risks, and decisions required.
•Manage expectations proactively, addressing scope, timeline, and deliverable questions before they become escalations.
•Translate customer requests into actionable delivery tasks, assess feasibility, flag out-of-scope requests, and route them to the right internal resource.
•Escalate risks and customer concerns early, with a clear recommendation.

Delivery Execution

•Manage multiple concurrent ZTNA implementations across US commercial customers.
•Own service delivery end to end: scope, schedule, budget, milestones, deliverables, and resource coordination.
•Maintain delivery documentation throughout each engagement, including project plans, status reports, risk logs, and go-live and close-out records.
•Coordinate AppGate delivery engineers on each project, ensuring clear task ownership and removing blockers.
•Run change control for all out-of-scope requests: prepare change requests and SOW amendments for commercial approval in Salesforce, and ensure no work proceeds without approved authorization and documentation.

Financial Accountability (P&L)

•Own the financial health of assigned projects, including hours burned against contracted hours, utilization, and billing accuracy.
•Identify revenue, margin, and schedule risk early; flag burn-rate deviations and propose corrective action before budget is exceeded.
•Drive timely milestone completion and customer sign-off to support accurate billing and revenue realization.
•Protect services margin by preventing unbilled scope: no out-of-scope work proceeds without an approved change order.

Delivery Quality and Governance

•Apply AppGate's global delivery methodology consistently across engagements.
•Keep engagements aligned to each customer's security posture, network segmentation, identity, and compliance objectives, not just go-live.
•Contribute to delivery documentation standards and templates used across the commercial book of business.
•Identify resource constraints and delivery bottlenecks, and propose solutions.
•Provide regular delivery and financial reporting to the RVP, Customer Solutions.

Internal Contribution

•Contribute to commercial capacity planning and resource forecasting.
•Support pre-sales by reviewing SOW drafts, validating scope and delivery feasibility, and flagging delivery risk before commitments are made. This role does not commit scope, timelines, or pricing to customers.

Required Qualifications

•5+ years of experience as a customer-facing project or delivery manager, including at least 3 years on cybersecurity or networking engagements.
•Experience managing complex B2B technology implementations.
•Demonstrated ability to manage scope, schedule, budget, and stakeholder expectations across structured, milestone-driven commercial IT or security projects.
•Experience managing project financials in a services P&L environment, including budgets, burn rate, utilization, and billing.
•Working knowledge of network segmentation, identity, and access control concepts sufficient to manage delivery without engineering translation.
•Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce and present delivery documentation to a professional standard.
•Ability to challenge customers and internal teams constructively when necessary.

Preferred Qualifications

•PMP, PRINCE2, or an equivalent project management credential. Proven delivery experience matters more than the credential.
•Experience delivering identity and access management (IAM), Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), or enterprise security platform deployments.

Travel

Occasional customer travel as project delivery requires.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age or any other federally protected class.  Further, AppGate is an affirmative action employer committed to taking positive steps to employ, advance in employment and otherwise afford equal employment opportunity to protected veterans and individuals with disabilities.  In furtherance of AppGate's policy regarding affirmative action and equal employment opportunity, AppGate has developed a written affirmative action program. This program is available for review upon request by any applicant or employee during normal business hours by contacting the company's EEO Coordinator. www.appgate.com/careers

jobs.title: Project Manager I-Center for Psychedelic Psychotherapy and Trauma Research
jobs.description:
Description

Job Description

We have an exciting opportunity to join our team as a full-time clinical research project manager in a high-profile, cutting-edge clinical research program on posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) under the direction of Principal Investigators Rachel Yehuda, Amy Lehrner, and Janine Flory. The project manager will be involved in research conducted by the Sinai Center for Psychedelic Psychotherapy and Trauma Research and the James J Peters VA Medical Center (Bronx). The project manager will create and execute plans for complex research projects that may include clinical trials and biological studies of PTSD. This position will include supervisory responsibility for research coordinators, and will answer to senior operations and investigative staff. The project manager will be responsible for oversight of: day to day operations of research studies, completion and maintenance of regulatory documents, facilitating project-related meetings and coordination with interdisciplinary research team. The manager will track project status and changes, notify management when issues arise, and assist with taking corrective action as needed.

Current studies in the lab include: clinical trials of psychedelic-assisted therapies, generation of stem cells for in vitro investigations of molecular underpinnings of PTSD, meditation for PTSD, and the use of hydrocortisone for patients being treated in emergency departments following a traumatic experience.

Responsibilities

Plans, directs and coordinates activities of designated project(s) to ensure that goals or objectives of the project are accomplished within prescribed time frame and funding parameters. Alters plans and makes recommendations for future project phases or future projects, based on lessons learned from the project.
May participate in budget development for the project.
Reviews project proposal or plan to determine time frame, funding limitations, procedures for accomplishing project(s).
Ensures all staffing requirements and allotment of available resources to various phases of project met. May contribute to the performance evaluation of the employees associated with the project scope and may evaluate vendors and consultants and their effectiveness and ability to deliver as promised.
Establishes work plan and staffing for each phase of project, and arranges for recruitment or assignment of project personnel.
Confers with staff to outline work plan and to assign duties, responsibilities, and scope of authority.
Directs and coordinates activities of project personnel to ensure project progresses on schedule and within prescribed budget, including consultants and other outside vendors.
Reviews status reports prepared by project personnel and modifies schedules or plans as required.
Prepares project reports for management, client, or others. Confers with project personnel to provide technical advice and to resolve problems.
May oversee participating members of the project to ensure communication is timely and accurate, and that the project needs are met, including documentation for the project.
Performs other related duties.

Qualifications

Bachelors degree or greater preferred, or combination of applicable work experience and education
3+ years of relevant experience with Masters degree; 5+ years with Bachelors degree; project management-specific experience preferred
Other qualifications include strong organizational, interpersonal, and communication skills; ability to work independently with careful attention to detail; flexibility and strong problem solving skills; experience in clinical research settings.

Employer Description

Strength through Unity and Inclusion

The Mount Sinai Health System is committed to fostering an environment where everyone can contribute to excellence. We share a common dedication to delivering outstanding patient care. When you join us, you become part of Mount Sinai’s unparalleled legacy of achievement, education, and innovation as we work together to transform healthcare. We encourage all team members to actively participate in creating a culture that ensures fair access to opportunities, promotes inclusive practices, and supports the success of every individual.

At Mount Sinai, our leaders are committed to fostering a workplace where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We strive to create an environment where collaboration, fairness, and continuous learning drive positive change, improving the well-being of our staff, patients, and organization. Our leaders are expected to challenge outdated practices, promote a culture of respect, and work toward meaningful improvements that enhance patient care and workplace experiences. We are dedicated to building a supportive and welcoming environment where everyone has the opportunity to thrive and advance professionally. Explore this opportunity and be part of the next chapter in our history.

About The Mount Sinai Health System

Mount Sinai Health System is one of the nation’s leading integrated academic health systems and one of the largest in the New York metropolitan area. Its comprehensive system includes seven hospitals, more than 400 outpatient practices, over 600 research and clinical laboratories, the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai, the Graduate School of Biomedical Sciences, and the Mount Sinai Phillips School of Nursing. Together, the Health System comprises approximately 48,000 employees, more than 9,000 physicians, and 8,600 nurses.

As a leading learning health system, Mount Sinai combines clinical expertise with scientific discovery to improve patient care while training the next generation of health care and biomedical leaders. The Health System provides care across every stage of life, from prenatal care through geriatrics, while advancing personalized medicine through artificial intelligence, data science, and biomedical research.

Mount Sinai is consistently recognized among the nation’s leading academic health systems for patient care, research, and education. The Mount Sinai Hospital is ranked No. 1 in New York by Newsweek® and No. 7 in the U.S. on the magazine’s 2026 World’s Best Hospitals list and No. 3 in the world in its World’s Best Smart Hospitals list. The Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai ranks No. 9 among U.S. medical schools and No. 1 among freestanding medical schools for National Institutes of Health grant funding, reflecting the strength of its scientific enterprise and leadership in biomedical research.

We do not discriminate, exclude, or treat individuals differently based on race, color, national origin, age, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are deeply committed to fostering an environment where all faculty, staff, students, trainees, patients, visitors, and the communities we serve feel respected and supported. Our goal is to create a healthcare and learning institution that actively works to remove barriers, address challenges, and promote fairness in all aspects of our organization.

jobs.title: Program Manager I
jobs.description:
Job Description And Duties

**This is a re-advertisement. Candidates who previously applied do not need to re-apply. Your application package is on file.**

Are you looking for an exciting and fast-paced career?

Join the California Governor's Office of Emergency Services (Cal OES) and be part of an organization that serves as a leader in emergency management and homeland security through dedicated service to all. We are looking for enthusiastic and motivated individuals to join our team. If you are interested in a challenging opportunity in a high-energy, team-oriented environment, you are encouraged to apply.

Under the general direction of the Program Manager II, the Program Manager I (PM I) plans, directs, and evaluates the work of the Readiness Unit to develop, maintain, and improve statewide recovery readiness policies, procedures, and tools. The Readiness Unit ensures that Cal OES Recovery Directorate maintains a fully prepared, skilled, and deployment-ready workforce by proactively identifying capability needs and developing the tools, training, procedures, and job aids required to support effective disaster recovery operations across California. The PM I ensures deployment training, position qualification support, and operational readiness for Joint Field Offices (JFOs), Area Field Offices (AFOs), and other recovery sites, while balancing routine workload with short notice tasks. The role includes supervisory responsibility for professional staff, administration of readiness programs, and the provision of technical assistance for, and development of, workshops and tabletop exercise that support recovery readiness and operational capability. May deploy to a JFO, AFO, or other recovery site to provide direct readiness and operational support.

The PM I advances recovery readiness objectives by fostering problem-solving, customer-focused innovation, and technical expertise; provides leadership in designing and delivering recovery-focused training initiatives; maintains accurate unit documentation, user guides, and standard operating procedures (SOP)'s; and ensures annual updates to readiness materials that support deployment and operational integration across recovery programs. Collaborates with other units to support system updates, process improvements, and operational enhancements within the deployment management system. Assists local governments and partner agencies by providing readiness guidance, coordination, and support to strengthen statewide disaster recovery capability.

Supports ESF-14 functions by coordinating information exchange between the State Operations Center (SOC) and Recovery during disasters. This includes sharing updates on recovery activities, receiving information on response operations, and ensuring alignment between response and recovery posture to support statewide situational awareness and decision-making. Contributes to inter-unit initiatives that improve readiness processes, supports updates to readiness tools and documentation, and assists with coordination efforts that ensure staff are prepared for disaster deployments. Anticipates the needs of disaster recovery operations, establishes and maintains relationships with internal and external stakeholders, and promotes organizational efficiency and operational excellence across readiness activities.

May be required to perform the same work tasks as subordinate staff, to ensure the mission, goals, and objectives of the unit/division/branch are met in the most timely and efficient manner.

You will find additional information about the job in the Duty Statement
.

Working Conditions

This position is located in the Recovery Readiness Unit in Mather, CA.

Hybrid Telework:
This position is eligible for a hybrid work schedule. Additional in office days may be required based on the business need.

DMV Pull Program:
Participation in the DMV Pull Program is required. The position(s) require(s) a valid Driver’s License (DL). You must answer the questions addressing your DL on your application. Ensure you provide your DL number, class, expiration date, and any endorsements and/or restrictions.

Conflict of Interest (COI):
This position is designated under the Conflict of Interest Code and is required to complete Form 700 within 30 days of appointment. Failure to comply with the Conflict of Interest Code requirements may void the appointment.

Department Information

The California Governor’s Office of Emergency Services (Cal OES) is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture by hiring and retaining individuals from a variety of backgrounds and personal experiences. Our employees are empowered with the tools and resources necessary to meet our mission, while continuing to expand equity and inclusion efforts at all levels of the organization. We are committed to the spirit and work required to ensure the safety and resilience of every community in California.

The California Governor’s Office of Emergency Services (Cal OES) is an emergency response, homeland security, and disaster recovery agency and as a result, is a dynamic and exciting place to work in a team-oriented environment. Cal OES provides training to enhance the understanding of emergency and incident management to all employees.

The Recovery Directorate is responsible for managing disaster recovery and providing assistance to local governments, special districts, certain nonprofit organizations, individuals, businesses and agricultural communities impacted by disasters. The Recovery Directorate ensures state and federal support are provided in an efficient and timely manner throughout the recovery process.

The Recovery Directorate is comprised of three sections — Recovery Operations, Hazard Mitigation, and Interagency Recovery Coordination. Recovery personnel are responsible for assisting in the management of statewide disaster recovery efforts, as well as assisting agricultural communities, businesses, certain nonprofit organizations, individuals, local governments and special districts impacted by disasters.

In the event of an emergency, employees may be contacted and requested to report to work in the event of an emergency. This contact may be outside of your normal working hours (evenings/nights, weekends, and holidays). This service may require irregular work hours, work locations other than the official duty location, and may include duties other than those specified in your official position description. Travel requirements in support of emergency operations may be extensive in nature (weeks to months), with little advance notice, and you may be required to relocate to emergency sites.

More information may be found here: Recovery Directorate | California Governor's Office of Emergency Services

Department Website: http://www.caloes.ca.gov

Desirable Qualifications

In addition to evaluating each candidate's relative ability, as demonstrated by quality and breadth of experience, the following factors will provide the basis for competitively evaluating each candidate:

Experience leading or supervising professional staff and managing program deliverables.
Knowledge of disaster recovery, deployment readiness, and emergency management operations (e.g., JFOs, AFOs).
Ability to develop and maintain SOPs, training materials, job aids, and readiness documentation.
Skill in planning and facilitating training, workshops, tabletop exercises, or drills.
Strong analytical skills to identify gaps, improve processes, and recommend solutions.
Experience using deployment or personnel-readiness tracking systems.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including briefings and reporting.
Ability to coordinate effectively with internal units, local governments, and partner agencies.
Ability to work in fast-paced, dynamic environments with shifting priorities.
Experience supporting interagency coordination, including ESF-14 or similar functions.

Ensure excellent project execution and client satisfaction, delivering projects on time, within scope, and on budget.
Collaborate with clients to define processes, use cases, and requirements that need to be supported by the platform, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
Facilitate functional and scoping workshops, advising clients on how to maximise the value from our solutions and services.
Translate business requirements into actionable work packages for the platform implementation team, ensuring technical alignment and feasibility.
Establish and manage project governance frameworks, including defining the schedule, milestones, key stakeholders, deliverables, risks, and budget oversight.
Drive continuous improvement of onboarding methodologies, ensuring they are scalable and adaptable to client needs.
Deliver comprehensive training to end users, including producing instructional materials, user guides, and manuals.
Proactively identify opportunities for product enhancement and collaborate with product management to drive new features and functionality.
Lead cross-functional teams, ensuring communication between engineering, product, and client stakeholders.

Experience in platform implementation; strong expertise in the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), along with familiarity with API integrations and cloud platforms, is essential.
Deep understanding of wealth management processes, investment advisory, and financial products; Proven experience in project management methodologies, including Agile (Scrum/Kanban), with an ability to manage the full project lifecycle from initiation to post-launch support.

Provides project management leadership and coordination for assigned Operational Technology (OT) initiatives, guiding projects from planning through completion. Applies Project Management Institute (PMI) methodologies and best practices to manage project scope, schedules, resources, budgets, risks, and deliverables. Facilitates collaboration among business and technical teams, executive sponsors, and key stakeholders to support project objectives, resolve obstacles, manage organizational change, and ensure successful project delivery.

Position Responsibilities

Lead assigned OT projects from initiation through completion, applying Project Management Institute (PMI) methodologies, best practices, and project management standards.
Develop project plans, roadmaps, work plans, resource strategies, funding estimates, scopes, deliverables, and objectives in collaboration with project sponsors and stakeholders.
Identify project resource requirements, coordinate subject matter expert participation, forecast staffing needs, and work with management to resolve resource allocation challenges.
Organize and facilitate project teams, meetings, and stakeholder communications; coordinate business, technical, Information Technology (IT), OT, and engineering resources.
Monitor project schedules, milestones, budgets, deliverables, and performance targets; identify potential delays, recommend corrective actions, and escalate issues as needed.
Manage project scope, schedule, and cost changes, obtaining appropriate approvals and communicating impacts to project sponsors and management.
Identify, assess, and monitor project risks, issues, and dependencies; maintain tracking logs and develop contingency plans to minimize potential impacts.
Provide project guidance, technical input, and recommendations to support decision-making, resolve conflicting priorities, and address sensitive stakeholder concerns.
Maintain regular communication with executive sponsors, management, business stakeholders, and strategic partners through status reports, meetings, and project updates.
Support project deliverables, including requirements development, process and system design, organizational change management, project documentation, and project management best-practice assessments.
Facilitate project closeout and transitions, including final reports, lessons learned, knowledge transfer, training, documentation, and coordination of project resource transitions.
Maintain project records, correspondence, and documentation in accordance with information security, records management, access control, and audit requirements.

Position Requirements

Education & Corresponding Experience

A bachelor’s degree in business administration, Computer Science, Information Technology, Management Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline is preferred.
10 years of experience is required with an applicable bachelor’s degree.
14 years of experience is required without a degree or a non-applicable bachelor’s degree.
Experience must include project management of IT Software and network infrastructure related projects and applications; integration of projects using industry standard methods and tools for managing schedules, dependencies, resources, funding and developing technical specifications and project plans for medium-to large-sized projects.
Service Desk or Operations and Maintenance (O&M) experience will not meet project experience requirements.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Company: Mascon
Location: Kingston or Ottawa, Ontario (based on the successful candidate)
Salary: $90,000–$115,000 per year, based on experience
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

About Mascon

Mascon Group is a growing construction company specializing in building restoration, general contracting, design-build and construction management services. With offices in Kingston and Ottawa, we deliver construction projects across multiple markets throughout Canada.

As part of our continued growth, we are seeking an experienced Construction Project Manager to oversee a large-scale commercial retail expansion program for a major U.S.-based client entering and expanding within the Canadian market.

Position Overview

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing multiple commercial construction projects simultaneously, including new-build retail locations, commercial fit-ups and renovations.

This position involves managing the entire project lifecycle, from initial feasibility assessments, design development and consultant coordination through tendering, procurement, construction and final turnover to the client.

We are looking for a highly organized, motivated individual who is comfortable working independently, managing multiple stakeholders and delivering projects within aggressive schedules and established budgets.

Key Responsibilities

Preconstruction & Design-Build

* Manage projects from initial feasibility through construction commencement.
* Coordinate with architects, structural engineers, mechanical and electrical consultants, and other design professionals.
* Oversee design development, building permit applications and municipal approvals.
* Develop preliminary construction budgets and project schedules.
* Review drawings and specifications for constructability, cost efficiencies and potential conflicts.
* Identify value engineering opportunities throughout the design process.

Tendering & Procurement

* Develop scopes of work and tender packages for subcontractors and suppliers.
* Manage the competitive tendering process across multiple geographical markets.
* Review subcontractor pricing, qualifications and scope coverage.
* Prepare detailed construction budgets and recommendations for client approval.
* Negotiate and award subcontractor and supplier contracts.
* Coordinate procurement of long-lead materials and equipment.

Construction & Project Management

* Manage multiple commercial construction projects concurrently.
* Coordinate site supervisors, subcontractors, suppliers and consultants.
* Develop, maintain and monitor detailed construction schedules.
* Oversee project financials, cost tracking, forecasting and profitability.
* Manage change orders, RFIs, shop drawings and material submissions.
* Ensure compliance with applicable building codes, health and safety regulations, and quality standards.
* Coordinate client-supplied equipment, fixtures, IT infrastructure and store installations.
* Manage inspections, deficiencies, project closeout and final turnover.

Client & Stakeholder Management

* Act as a primary point of contact between Mascon Group, the client and project stakeholders.
* Participate in regular client and consultant coordination meetings.
* Provide detailed project progress reports, budget updates and schedule forecasts.
* Proactively identify project risks and implement solutions to minimize delays and cost overruns.
* Maintain strong professional relationships with clients, consultants and subcontractors.

Qualifications & Experience

* Minimum 5 years of construction project management experience.
* Experience in commercial construction, retail fit-ups, general contracting or design-build delivery.
* Strong understanding of architectural, structural, mechanical and electrical drawings.
* Demonstrated experience managing subcontractor tendering, procurement and contract administration.
* Experience managing multiple construction projects simultaneously.
* Strong understanding of construction budgets, scheduling and financial reporting.
* Knowledge of the Ontario Building Code and applicable construction regulations.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and construction project management software.
* Excellent communication, negotiation and organizational skills.
* Valid driver’s licence and willingness to travel to project locations as required.
* Post-secondary education in construction management, civil engineering, architectural technology or a related discipline is considered an asset.
* PMP, Gold Seal Certification or equivalent industry designation is considered an asset.

What We Offer

* Competitive annual salary of $90,000–$115,000, based on qualifications and experience.
* Flexibility to work from either our Kingston or Ottawa office.
* Long-term, permanent employment with a growing construction company.
* Opportunity to manage a large-scale national commercial retail expansion program.
* A diverse portfolio of commercial construction and design-build projects.
* Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.
* A collaborative, entrepreneurial and results-driven working environment.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their projects from start to finish. The ideal candidate understands both the technical and financial aspects of construction, is proactive in resolving challenges and can confidently manage relationships with clients, consultants and subcontractors.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Project Manager looking to take on greater responsibility and play a key role in the delivery of a growing national construction program.

Join Mascon Group and help us build our next chapter of growth.

Interested candidates are encouraged to apply with their resume and relevant project experience.

jobs.description:
포지션 소개

엑시나의 CXL Computational Memory 제품이 고객 환경에서 안정적으로 도입되고 운영될 수 있도록, SW 제품 개발부터 검증·릴리즈·고객 적용까지 전 과정을 연결하는 역할입니다.
MX1의 고객 도입 확대와 양산 준비에 맞춰, SW팀 소속으로 펌웨어·드라이버·런타임·SDK·컴파일러 등 여러 SW 영역의 개발 계획과 제품 요구사항을 조율합니다. SQA, Product Engineering(PE)/Validation, 마케팅 및 고객 접점 조직과 함께 기능별 우선순위, 검증 범위, 릴리즈 일정과 고객 전달 내용을 일치시킵니다.
고객과 사업의 요구를 실행 가능한 개발 계획으로 구체화하고, 일정과 품질의 위험을 조기에 드러내며, 합의한 사항이 실제 제품과 고객 경험으로 이어질 때까지 관리합니다. 개발 목표 조율과 일정 관리, 부서 간 조율, 자료 취합과 고객 후속 대응을 체계화하는 것이 이 역할의 중요한 목표입니다.
담당 업무

SW 요구사항및 우선순위관리
— 고객·마케팅·PE/Validation의 요청을 취합하고, 개발팀과 함께 사용 시나리오, 완료 기준, 제품별 지원 범위와 우선순위를 구체화
통합 개발 일정 운영
— SW 영역별 개발·통합·검증·배포 계획을 연결하고, 담당자·의존성·주요 마일스톤·위험 요소를 관리하며 일정 또는 범위 변경 시 영향과 대안을 조율
릴리즈계획 및 실행 관리
— 정기 마일스톤과 긴급 수정의 운영 기준을 정립하고, 기능 확정·코드 동결·검증·배포 일정을 조율하며 성능 및 호환성 평가 현황 관리
SQA 및 PE/Validation 협업
— 고객 사용 환경과 제품 요구사항에 맞는 검증 범위·완료 기준·역할 분담을 합의하고, 결함 우선순위와 재검증 현황을 추적하여 릴리즈 판단에 필요한 근거 취합
내부 의사결정및 대외 커뮤니케이션조율
— 개발 가능 범위와 검증 결과를 바탕으로 기능·성능·일정에 대한 설명을 일치시키고, 고객 약속이나 우선순위 변경이 필요한 사안의 의사결정 지원과 후속 실행 관리
고객 기술 대응 조율
— 필요 시 마케팅 및 고객 접점 조직과 함께 기술 미팅에 참여하고, 문의·이슈의 초기 분류와 재현 정보 확보, 담당 조직 연결, 대응 일정·진행 상황 안내 및 해결 여부 확인

이런 분을 찾습니다

기술적으로

펌웨어·드라이버·런타임·SDK·컴파일러 등 시스템 SW의 전반적인 구성과 주요 의존성을 이해하고, 각 영역의 기술 담당자와 함께 담당 범위와 해결 순서를 정리할 수 있는 분
고객의 요청을 그대로 전달하는 데서 나아가 사용 목적과 문제를 파악하고, 개발팀이 판단할 수 있는 요구사항과 완료 기준으로 구체화할 수 있는 분
개발 완료, 검증 완료, 고객 배포 가능 상태의 차이를 이해하고, 테스트 결과와 잔여 위험을 바탕으로 릴리즈 준비 수준을 설명할 수 있는 분
기술적 제약과 사업적 우선순위를 함께 이해하고, 일정·범위·품질 간 선택지를 명확히 제시할 수 있는 분

업무 스타일

회의와 현황 보고에서 끝내지 않고, 결정 사항의 담당자·기한·완료 기준을 명확히 하여 실제 실행과 종료까지 챙기는 분
개발팀, SQA, PE/Validation, 마케팅과 고객의 서로 다른 관점을 이해하고, 합의를 이끌어낼 수 있는 분
불확실하거나 지연되는 사안을 조기에 공유하고, 확인된 사실과 미확인 사항을 구분하여 후속 조치를 구체화하는 분
필요한 정보가 한 번 정리되어 여러 팀에서 활용되도록 업무를 단순화하는 분
변화가 빠른 환경에서 직접 문서를 작성하고 이슈를 정리하며, 조직 규모에 맞는 실용적인 프로세스를 만들어가는 분

지원 자격

필수

SW 개발, 시스템 SW, 기술 기반 Product/Program Management 등 관련 실무 경력 8년이상

여러 기술 조직이 참여하는 SW 제품 또는 플랫폼의 개발·검증·릴리즈를 주도적으로 조율한 경험

고객 또는 외부 파트너와 기술 요구사항, 이슈 및 일정을 협의하고 내부 개발 조직의 대응을 조율한 경험
기술 문서, 릴리즈 노트, 진행 현황 및 의사결정 자료를 목적과 대상에 맞게 작성할 수 있는 역량
글로벌 고객 및 파트너와 기술 문서와 이메일을 주고받고, 업무 미팅을 진행할 수 있는 영어 커뮤니케이션 역량
전산·컴퓨터·전기전자공학 또는 관련 분야 학사 이상, 혹은 이에 준하는 실무 경험

jobs.description:
About the Opportunity:

Software engineering is changing as AI takes on more implementation work. Increasingly, the most valuable technical people will be those who can understand complex problems, work directly with customers, exercise strong product judgment, and coordinate the people needed to deliver a result.

Greylock recently led the Series A in a New York infrastructure company building the simulation platform for the next generation of physical AI.

The company helps teams building robotics, autonomous systems, perception systems, and other physical products test their systems in high-fidelity cloud simulation. This lets customers iterate faster, catch failures earlier, and reduce expensive real-world testing. The founding team brings deep experience across AI, autonomy, simulation, and large-scale software systems and is building a highly technical, in-person team in New York.

About the Role:

The company is looking for a Deployment Strategist
to work at the intersection of customers, engineering, and product.

You will work closely with technical customers to understand their workflows, identify the highest-impact problems, and turn ambiguous needs into clear deployment plans. You will coordinate across simulation, engineering, product, and commercial teams to move projects from discovery to working solutions.

This role is for someone technical who also brings strong communication, product judgment, and stakeholder management. You will manage multiple engagements, create clarity across teams, and bring customer learnings back into the product to help turn one-off deployments into repeatable capabilities.

What You’ll Do:

Embed with customer teams to understand their workflows, technical challenges, and highest-impact problems
Turn ambiguous customer needs into clear deployment plans and own engagements from discovery through implementation
Build trusted relationships with engineers and technical stakeholders while coordinating across product, simulation, and commercial teams
Manage multiple workstreams, tradeoffs, and dependencies to keep deployments moving
Bring what you learn from customers back into the product, identifying recurring needs that should become reusable platform capabilities

What They’re Looking For:

1 to 5 years of experience in software engineering, customer engineering, technical consulting, solutions engineering, technical program management, or a related role
A strong technical foundation and the ability to earn credibility with engineers
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and the ability to understand the real problem behind a customer request
Strong ownership and judgment, with the ability to bring structure to ambiguous, open-ended problems
High learning velocity, product intuition, and comfort working across engineering, product, and customer problems in a fast-moving environment

The company is looking for someone with a strong technical foundation, high learning velocity, strong user intuition, and the ability to connect customer needs with what engineering should build. You do not need to come in as a robotics, simulation, or physical AI expert. The company is looking for someone with a strong technical foundation, high learning velocity, and the communication skills to connect customers with engineering.

Our client is looking for a PM who makes FDEs 10x more effective. You are part product manager and part engagement leader. When we ship an AI operating system in weeks, it's because someone is partnering with the engineering team to keep priorities and requirements clear, the client aligned, and the project moving — without touching a line of code. That's this role. You are the connective tissue between world-class engineers and enterprise clients who need to understand what they're building and why it's working. The implementation, from kick-off to close. You're running the client check-in in the morning, synthesizing engineering output into an executive brief by noon, and building the value measurement framework before the week ends. As the practice scales, you build the processes and playbooks that make the next engagement faster than this one.

What you bring.
2+ years running complex, multi-workstream projects — in consulting, operations, or technical implementation. A track record of keeping things on time without being the one doing the technical work. Real credibility in client-facing settings, up to the C-suite. Specific, practiced AI tool usage — not "I use ChatGPT sometimes," but a genuine workflow built around AI that improves the quality of your output. Genuine curiosity about how software gets built and the drive to climb a steep technical learning curve fast.

Level.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
We are hiring Program Managers to lead each of our communities: K-12 & Youth Sports, Higher Education, Olympic & Paralympic Sport, Women's Sports and Sports Technology.

Team:
GSV Sports
Location:
Remote, U.S.-based, travel required, offices & teams in Chicago & NYC
Type:
Full-time

Who we are
GSV Sports is a high-growth, mission-driven startup at the intersection of sports, business, education, philanthropy and innovation. From youth and college athletics to the pro leagues and the Olympic movement, sports is being transformed, and none of its biggest questions can be answered inside a single silo. We believe sports is life's original learning and leadership accelerator and a cornerstone of the American Dream, and that all people deserve equal access to the future, with high-quality sport a critical part of it. We are the team behind the ASU+GSV Summit, which grew from 350 attendees to more than 7,000 leaders a year and was called "the Davos of Education" by Forbes. After 17 years and a successful exit in 2025, we are bringing that experience to sports. We are not the experts.

What we do very well is bring together people who don't ordinarily share a room, and build the connective tissue between them: lasting relationships, commercial opportunities and meaningful impact. Our community drives the change.

In October 2026, 350+ leaders from 240+ organizations joined us at the Obama Presidential Center in Chicago for Rebooting the American Dream , more than double our target. Next is our flagship gathering in Nashville, July 25 to 27, 2027, and a year-round platform beyond it.

How we work
Everybody builds with heart.
We are a small team. Everyone owns outcomes, not tasks, and no job is too small for any of us.
Excellence, every time.
We hold a high bar on everything we touch. Every name, title, quote approval and room assignment is right, because the people in our room deserve it.
Insatiable curiosity.
We read widely, ask the next question and seek out the people who see things differently. None of us is finished learning.
Startup pace, steady judgment.
We are doers and we move quickly: we share a first pass and make it better together. We also know when to slow down, keep confidence and get it right.
Working with senior leaders from day one.
You will have exposure & join conversations with presidents, commissioners, CEOs and Olympians in your first weeks, as a trusted partner to them and to us.
AI-native.
We use AI every day to work faster and better, and we look to you to help us find new ways.
The magic is the mix.
Our communities overlap on purpose. The best conversations put people who rarely sit together at one table.

Who you are
Strategic.
You see the whole field, know which relationships and moves matter most, and turn them into a plan that gets results.
Bold.
You go after the biggest names and the hardest yes, hold your own with presidents and CEOs, and follow up until it happens.
Always on.
You are proactive, you listen closely, and you follow up before anyone asks.
Insatiably curious.
You want to know how every part of sport works and where it is going. You read everything and come back with a point of view.
Broad perspective.
You see sport from every side, the classroom, the athletic department, the investor, the brand and the athlete, and you connect them.
Organized and clear.
You track dozens of people and moving pieces without dropping a thread, and you write short emails that get answered.
Fluent in your corner of sport.
You follow the policy, the money, the research and the people shaping your community, and you know who is doing the most interesting work.
AI fluent.
You already use AI tools to work faster, and you want to push further.
Calm under pressure.
You stay composed as details shift in the weeks before a gathering.

Why now & your role
Each Program Manager will own one of our communities all year and build that community's program for Nashville. You will partner with the leaders and organizations moving your area forward, help more of them join, and turn what starts in our rooms into working groups that deliver. This is a builder role, not a support role. GSV Sports brings the people who set policy into the same room as the athletes, coaches, students and founders who live it.

Why join us
A proven team, a new platform.
The founders who built and exited the ASU+GSV Summit, now bringing that experience and network to sports.
Build it from the beginning.
You will be one of our first hires, with real ownership of a community and its program.
An extraordinary community.
Presidents, commissioners, CEOs, Olympians, founders and investors, at a moment when the future of sport is being reimagined.
Grow with the platform.
A small team where your work is visible, your ideas matter and strong performance leads to more responsibility.

What you will own
The community
The leaders, institutions, governing bodies, companies and athletes that make up your community.
Study the ecosystem, build relationships, and nurture existing relationships with the leaders & organizations moving your community. Keep a living map of who matters and what they are working on.
Stay close all year through research, calls, notes, webinars, convenings and our Leadership Council.
Bring athletes, coaches and practitioners into the room alongside the people who set policy.

The Nashville Program
Shape your community's track for Nashville around the questions that matter most right now.
Recruit speakers, fantastic moderators, and design sessions that are provocative and practical.
Own every session from first outreach to the day itself.

The follow-through
Work with the leaders and organizations already doing the work, and help more of them join us.
Run working groups between gatherings, each with an owner and a deliverable.
Track progress and report it back to the community.

The partners
Work with our partnerships team on researching the foundations, governing bodies and companies that invest in your community.
Prepare briefs and materials for partner meetings to support conversations.

How you will spend your week
Talk to your community.
10 to 15 conversations a week with leaders, athletes, coaches and operators.
Turn conversations into the program.
Every good call ends with a next step: a speaker, a session idea, a partner lead, an introduction or a registration.
Find the human stories.
The athlete, coach, student or founder whose story makes a hard question real. Our best sessions put them next to the people who set policy.
Build your champions.
Recruit co-curators and attendees who open doors and bring others into the room.
Go where your community gathers.
The conferences, convenings and campuses where your community does its work. Come back with names, notes and next steps.

Your first 60 days, and Nashville
Days 1 to 30, Listen.
Meet dozens of leaders across your community. Build the map. Learn how we run a program end to end.
Days 31 to 60, Shape.
Develop your community's topics for Nashville and confirm your first speakers.
July 25 to 27, 2027, Nashville.
Hundreds of leaders from your community in your rooms, and new partners ready to join the work.

What success looks like
Your community knows us.
Within 60 days, a living map of the top 150 organizations and 300 leaders in your community.
Your community shows up.
The leaders on your map register for Nashville, and your community reaches the registration target we set together.
Your track is the best in the building.
A fantastic list of speakers confirmed representing the full breadth of your community, and sessions people are still talking about in the fall.
Partners see the value.
Your relationships turn into partner conversations for the founding team, and every partner in your area gets real value.
You become the team’s community owner & expert.
Your weekly brief is the one the founders read first, and when a question about your community comes up, everyone turns to you.

Experience
3-6+ years in K-12 or higher education, youth or college sport, the Olympic and Paralympic movement, women's sports, sports technology, policy, a nonprofit, a sports organization or a fast-growing company
A track record of running complex programs with senior stakeholders
Former athletes, coaches, teachers and operators are strongly encouraged to apply
Bachelor's degree

This role requires travel, including to Nashville, partner meetings and campus visits, and extended hours in the weeks before each gathering.

We are one of the most well respected commercial construction company in Northern Virginia, known for our commitment to quality, safety, and sustainability. This is a reputation for delivering high-quality construction projects on time and within budget. 

We have completed a wide range of commercial buildings, including office buildings, medical facilities, retail spaces, and government buildings. We already have a backlog for the next 6yrs.

About The Job You’re Considering

We have an exciting opportunity to join our Project Management Office (PMO) Team supporting the Cloud Infrastructure business in the UK. PMO forms part of the Engagement Management Community. We provide administrative support to Engagement Managers primarily; this support can take many forms from process definition and governance to simple assistance to free up Engagement Managers time to focus on more complex delivery issues. The team are based across the UK, with a variety of skillsets from all-rounders to subject matter experts. Our Graduate Project Managers join our PMO teams to build up knowledge and experience within project delivery and the technology industry before moving on to manage projects of their own.

We’ll give you the training and support needed to develop as a PMO Analyst where you will work as part of the UK PMO Team reporting to a PMO Lead/PMO Manager depending on the role. Whilst also giving you the experience of working alongside our project managers and eventually giving you development opportunities to take on projects of your own.

Hybrid working:
The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

Your Role

Your role will involve providing back-office support across a broad range of core services/processes within project management including Financial Management, Planning Coordination, Reporting, Resource Capacity Management, Change Management, Communication and PMO Administration – in time you should hopefully get to work across each area.

This working environment enables our team members to develop their skills and knowledge which can and has resulted in promotion to higher grades as well as opening up opportunities to pursue their career in the Engagement Management community. We operate a mentoring scheme to help develop our team members and give them the tools to approach whatever situation they may face on their assignments.

In addition, you will also join our vastly developing CIS UK Graduate and Apprentice community, where you will be able to learn and network with people in a similar career journey.

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini building an inclusive future is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We have built a representative and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Graduate Development Experience

Our graduate experience is designed to help you build the skills, mindset, and confidence to thrive in a rapidly evolving, AI-enabled world. From day one, you'll be part of a community focused on innovation, collaboration, and delivering accelerated solutions for our clients.

Through a combination of professional and technical development, client experience, and mentorship, you’ll develop the capabilities to solve complex challenges, innovate with confidence, and contribute from the very start of your career. Supercharge your development with access to our best-in-class content providers and technology partners including Harvard Business, Microsoft, OpenAI, and more.

Built around modules that encourage you to think creatively, embrace new technologies and turn ideas into meaningful impact. You’ll work alongside leaders and experts to build future-focused skills that prepare you for long-term success in technology, business, and consulting careers.

Your Skills And Experience

To be eligible for this programme, you must have obtained, or be studying towards, a minimum 2:2 degree. If you are currently studying, you must have completed your degree prior to proposed start date. We recognise that mitigating circumstances can have an impact on academic performance. If you have experienced any circumstances that you would like us to take into consideration, please provide details in your application.

We Are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini Is Proud To Be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) Under The UK Government’s Disability Confident Scheme. As Part Of Our Commitment To Inclusive Recruitment, We Will Offer An Interview To All Candidates Who

Declare they have a disability, and
Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Your Security Clearance

Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS)

To be successfully appointed to this role you will need to undergo Baseline Personnel Security Standard checks. There are no nationality or residency restrictions, although if you have resided outside of the UK within the last 3 years, further checks may be required.

There are other criteria and checks required for BPSS, and throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

Make It Real – What Does It Mean For You?

Impactful Experiences

You will reimagine what’s possible: creating value for the world's leading organisations through technology to build a sustainable, more inclusive future. You will work with a range of clients all with a unique set of business, technological and societal ambitions, which will make a real impact across the UK.

Shape Your Path

You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.

Why You Should Consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask. When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts. We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible. It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future. By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is the business transformation partner for enterprises in the age of AI. We help organizations imagine and build an intelligent, sustainable future, combining AI, technology and human ingenuity to transform how they operate, innovate and grow. With unique end-to-end capabilities spanning strategy, technology, engineering and intelligent operations, we bring together deep industry expertise and market-leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data to turn ambition into measurable business outcomes at scale. Supported by a robust ecosystem of partners and nearly 60 years of expertise, Capgemini is a responsible and diverse global organization of over 410,000 team members in more than 50 countries. jobs.title: Sr. Systems Technical Program Manager, Field Integration and Testing
jobs.description:
Description

Within the Experience Validation organization, the Field Integration and Testing (FIT) team pioneers end-to-end network field validation, testing Leo's full signal path from the customer terminal through gateway infrastructure to the internet, in real customer environments that labs cannot fully replicate. We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to drive the execution of FIT's core testing operations and its automated Solution Lab remote test fleet. You will be managing the remote test automation and debugging and you are the connective tissue between FIT and Leo engineering, keeping testing running with a fast-moving release cadence of new customer terminals, firmware, and mobile app builds.

Key job responsibilities

Own fleet management of remote Solution Labs across EMEA, a core FIT workstream that keeps automated testing and verification infrastructure operational for engineering and product teams.
Manage and modify AWS container-based workloads to meet evolving test requirements while maintaining security bar.
Coordinate execution of country-specific functional test cases (like regional IP routing and country specific service plans) and B2B/B2C use cases across Solution Labs.
Drive dependencies end-to-end, including Beta Ops provisioning, hardware delivery, and spot enablement.
TPM-found issues with relevant stakeholders, manage schedules, risks, and open items, and maintain data-backed status reporting for leadership.
Support Solution Lab and demo center expansion into future markets.

A day in the life

You might start your morning with your daily Solution Lab health report. It shows a test case failing at a remote site in another country. You find no known issue that matches, so you remote into the lab and confirm the failure is real. You capture the logs and open a ticket for engineering, with the evidence they need to act quickly. Next, a product team asks for access to another Solution Lab so they can validate their latest release in a real end-to-end environment. It's their first time in the lab, so you walk them through how to use it and set them up to succeed. After lunch, you join a planning session with the international expansion team, who are eager to get their new Solution Lab running. You brief them on the status of the technical enablers and gather their feedback, so the site also works as a customer-facing demo center. Later, you lead the issue review, where you summarize the top issues across the labs and work with engineering teams to drive improvements. Throughout it all, you turn signals from the field into action and help teams ship with confidence.

About The Team

Our team validates the Amazon Leo customer experience in the field and helps Leo teams test in the real world. Our mission is to find potential issues before end users see them. We run a global network of Solution Labs and field test sites where teams across Leo validate their releases end to end, under real conditions. Collaboration is central to how we work. You'll partner closely with engineering, product, and operations teams to turn field insights into a better product. If you want to see first-hand how Leo performs for real customers, this is the team for you.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

As part of the GE HealthCare MR organization, the USCAN MR Clinical AI Implementation Specialist – icobrain will be responsible for leading the successful deployment of icobrain at customer sites across the U.S. and Canada, from project kickoff through go-live and handoff to ongoing support.

This is a newly created role, added to support the continued growth of icobrain within GE HealthCare MR. The successful candidate will join the existing icobrain Implementation Specialist in USCAN, sharing the customer implementation workload and helping to strengthen and scale how implementations are delivered.

This role sits at the intersection of technology and clinical workflow. The successful candidate will plan and execute technical software implementations, connecting icobrain's cloud-based platform with customer MR scanners, PACS, and RIS environments through DICOM and HL7, while making sure each deployment fits the way the customer's MR department works day to day.

The role operates within a matrixed organization, reporting into GE HealthCare MR while dedicated specifically to icobrain. The Implementation Specialist will partner closely with their fellow icobrain Implementation Specialist, MR Sales, the Clinical AI Sales Specialist, Customer Success, icometrix product and support teams, GE HealthCare service and IT/security teams, and customer stakeholders. Across all of these relationships, the customer always comes first.

Because icobrain is a growing part of the GE HealthCare MR portfolio, this role will also help formulate and document the implementation process itself, building the repeatable workflows, playbooks, and standards that allow the team to scale.

This is a primarily remote role, with most implementation activity, including kickoffs, configuration, testing, and customer meetings, conducted virtually through phone and Microsoft Teams. Travel to customer sites will be required as needed for key milestones such as go-lives, workflow assessments, and escalations.

The ideal candidate brings a client-first mindset to every interaction and is self-motivated, proactive, and highly organized, someone who takes control of issues and is eager to drive them to resolution.

Job Description

Lead end-to-end implementations: Own icobrain deployments from contract handoff through go-live, including kickoff, scoping, scheduling, configuration, testing, training coordination, and transition to Customer Success.
Put the client first: Serve as the customer's primary point of contact throughout implementation, setting clear expectations, communicating proactively, and ensuring a positive experience at every step.
Integrate icobrain into the customer environment: Configure and validate DICOM connectivity and routing between MR scanners, PACS, and the icobrain cloud platform, and support HL7 interfaces and RIS integration for orders and results as required.
Align the solution with MR department workflow: Work with MR technologists, radiologists, neuroradiologists, and imaging leaders to understand current workflows, protocols, and reading practices, and configure icobrain to fit seamlessly into them.
Navigate security and IT requirements: Partner with customer IT and information security teams on security questionnaires, network and gateway configuration, firewall and access requirements, and data privacy reviews, including HIPAA and applicable Canadian privacy requirements.
Take ownership and drive to resolution: Proactively identify risks, troubleshoot technical issues, and coordinate across customer and internal teams to resolve them quickly, keeping projects on schedule and stakeholders informed.
Formulate and document processes: Working with the existing Implementation Specialist, help design, standardize, and document implementation processes, checklists, playbooks, and best practices for icobrain in USCAN, and continuously refine them based on lessons learned.
Build relationships, internally and externally: Develop trusted relationships with customer clinical, IT, and administrative stakeholders and with GE HealthCare MR Sales, Clinical AI Sales, Customer Success, service, and product teams, always keeping the customer's needs at the center.
Manage multiple projects with discipline: Track milestones, risks, actions, and documentation in established tools, and provide clear, timely status updates to customers and internal leadership.
Support existing customers and contract transitions: Partner with Customer Success on reconfigurations, upgrades, site expansions, and the technical aspects of transitioning legacy icometrix customers to GE HealthCare agreements.
Bring the voice of the customer back to the organization: Share implementation insights, recurring technical issues, and customer feedback with Product, Customer Success, and MR leadership to improve both the product and the implementation experience.

Required Qualifications

3+ years of experience leading technical software implementations, ideally in healthcare IT, medical imaging, clinical software, or a related field.
Working knowledge of cloud applications and SaaS deployment models, including connectivity, gateways, and cloud security considerations.
Solid understanding of DICOM and HL7 fundamentals, such as DICOM routing, AE titles, and modality worklists, and HL7 order and result messaging.
Understanding of RIS and PACS systems and how they interact within radiology workflow.
Knowledge of healthcare IT security and privacy, including network security, access controls, security questionnaires, and HIPAA.
Proven project management skills, with the ability to run multiple implementations at the same time and keep them on track.
An excellent client-first mindset, with a track record of building trusted relationships with customers while working effectively with internal teams.
Self-motivated and proactive, comfortable taking control of a situation and eager to drive issues to resolution with minimal direction.
Highly organized, with strong documentation skills and experience creating or improving processes, playbooks, or standard work.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to clinical, IT, and business audiences.
Ability to work effectively in a matrixed organization, collaborating across MR, icobrain, Customer Success, service, and product teams while maintaining ownership of assigned implementations.

Preferred

Hospital or healthcare background is strongly preferred, ideally in MRI or radiology (for example, MR technologist, PACS or imaging informatics, or clinical applications).
Understanding of MR department workflow, including scheduling, protocoling, image acquisition, and reading and reporting, is strongly preferred.
Experience with clinical AI, neuroimaging, or advanced visualization software is a plus.
Ability to work effectively in a primarily remote model, with travel as needed for customer go-lives, site visits, and other key milestones.
Most importantly, a genuine commitment to making every customer successful with icobrain and to advancing MR and neurological care through clinical AI.

Strong pipeline of multifamily developments throughout the region.
